# Provenance: prusaslicer

Copied unmodified on 2026-10-25 from `modules/gcode-parser/test/fixtures/prusaslicer/` (gcode-parser 0.8.5), so this module's integration test has a file from each slicer without reaching into another module. Generator, version, settings and licence as stated there, reproduced below.

Only `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.gcode` and `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.bgcode` are copied here; `test_vase.gcode` stays in gcode-parser.

PrusaSlicer is not installed here, so these three files are checked-in upstream samples, copied unmodified on 2026-10-25 from the cloned repositories under `.reference/repos`. All are AGPL-3.0 (both repositories carry the AGPL-3.0 `LICENSE`).

| File                                                  | Source                                                                                                                                                                          | Generated by                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.gcode`, `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.bgcode` | libbgcode (`https://github.com/prusa3d/libbgcode`) commit `d4da9073616d70a43c151e8c1d7fbff879d2e08a`, `tests/data/mini_cube_ps2.8.1.{gcode,bgcode}`                             | PrusaSlicer 2.8.1 on 2024-10-21 (file header `; generated by PrusaSlicer 2.8.1`, bgcode `Producer=PrusaSlicer 2.8.1`), MK4S, 0.2 mm layers, arc fitting `emit_center`. A twin pair of the same slice. |
| `test_vase.gcode`                                     | PrusaSlicer (`https://github.com/prusa3d/PrusaSlicer`) commit `30ef59195e0f3ee6f270b185bb5f9fb5f349f81f` (last commit touching the file), `resources/test_data/test_vase.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.0-alpha1 on 2025-03-06 (file header), MK3MMU2 profile with five filaments, vase mode, 0.2 mm layers, arc fitting disabled.                                                            |

Not present: a generated 20 mm cube and a multi-material print (the upstream `test_multimaterial.gcode` is 12 MB, over the 5 MB cap). See `../manifest.json` (`pending`).
